Component sheet

The shared pieces used by all three example pages. Use the account button in the header to flip this whole sheet between Light, Dark and Auto. Each block names the shadcn/ui component and Tailwind pattern it maps to.

Logo variant per background

Logos are used exactly as supplied and are never recoloured. Pick the file whose ink suits the ground. White ink on purple, black and dark grounds. Purple or black ink on white and light grounds. Header and footer stay purple in both colour modes, so they always use the white linear logo.

Brand purple · white linear

Header, mobile menu top bar, footer. SVG supplied.

White or light · purple stack

Sign-in cards, print, light-mode empty states. SVG supplied.

Purple tint · purple stack

Tinted panels in light mode. SVG supplied.

Dark surface · white stack

Dark-mode standalone pages (login, errors). SVG supplied.

White · purple linear

Light-mode linear lock-up. SVG converted from the supplied PDF.

White · black stack

Mono print or one-colour use. SVG converted from the supplied PDF.

Note the supplied logo purple is a different shade from the UI purple (#7413dc), as in the brand files. Never put the purple logo on a dark surface (about 2.5:1) or the white logo on a light surface. The supplied linear black file reads “Swindon”, not “Wiltshire”, so it is held back in assets/logos/_check-county until a Wiltshire version is supplied.

Header

DPIA layout kept: purple bar, white linear logo, nav links with a 4px underline for the current page, actions on the right, off-canvas menu below 768px. New: a site title slot after a thin divider. Each site supplies title, nav items (icon + label) and actions. The site title is limited to 60 characters (the build rejects longer ones), so it fits on two lines on desktop and three on mobile. The header does not change in dark mode. The account button on the right holds the colour mode control (see next section).

Desktop, long title wraps to two lines
Mobile, title drops to its own row (up to 3 lines, never truncated)
Mobile menu open (shadcn Sheet, side right)
Keyboard focus on a nav link, and the Skip to content link

shadcn: Sheet + Button variant="ghost" + DropdownMenu (user menu). Tailwind: bg-primary text-primary-foreground, nav link border-b-4 border-transparent aria-[current=page]:border-white.

Account menu, colour mode and footer

The header ends with an account button (circle-user icon when signed out, the user’s initials when signed in). It opens a popover holding sign-in or the user’s details, the colour mode control (Light, Dark, Auto) and sign out. The control is a three-way slider: a purple thumb slides to the chosen option, which also shows white text and a tick. Auto follows the device and is the default. Stored in one cookie shared across all wiltshirescouts.org.uk sites. Because every site gets the header, every site gets the control. On mobile the button sits beside the menu button and the popover opens full width under the header.

Desktop: popover open, signed in (table page)
Mobile: popover open, signed out (content page)
Popover contents: signed out, signed in, and colour only (sites with no accounts)

Footer

Every footer carries Privacy policy, wiltshirescouts.org.uk and #PlaceToBelong. “Made by” and the version number are an optional site slot (as on DPIA). Stacks on mobile.

Form fields

Label above, hint, control, error. Required fields get a red asterisk (hidden from screen readers, which hear the error text instead); optional fields are left unmarked. Optional fields carry no marker. Errors combine a thick left border, a circle-alert icon and the words “Error:” and the message, so colour is never the only signal. 48px minimum control height.

shadcn: Field/Form + Label, Input, Select, Textarea, RadioGroup, Checkbox, Alert variant="destructive". Tailwind: min-h-12 border-2 border-input rounded-lg focus-visible:ring-[3px] ring-ring aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:border-l-[6px].

Sortable table headings

Every sortable heading is a real button inside a th with aria-sort. Unsorted shows up-down arrows; ascending shows an up arrow; descending a down arrow, in a tinted pill with heavier stroke. Each button also carries hidden text saying the current state and what activating it does, and a polite live region announces the change.

Narrow screens

Default (up to about six columns): below 640px each row becomes a card with label and value pairs, the column headings stay in the DOM for screen readers, and sorting moves to a “Sort by” select with a direction button above the list. Alternative for wide, many-column tables: keep the table, scroll sideways and pin the first column.

Page styles

One theme, three frames. Standard (compact purple header with site title and nav) for content, tables and admin. Hero (tall purple band, large logo, icon, title and intro, then a teal ribbon; the content card overlaps the band) for sign-up forms. Centred card inside the standard header for sign-in. Library, information panel and email pages use the standard frame. The ribbon colour is one token (--ribbon, teal today).

Typography (Scouts design system, Nunito Sans)

Weights follow the design system: Black 900 for h1 and h2, Extra Bold 800 for h3, h4 and the local name under a logo, Bold 700 for buttons, labels and calls to action, Regular 400 for body text. Light 300 is only for body text on plain white and is not used on the lilac page. Fonts are the self-hosted files from dpia-tool.

Heading two, Black 900

Heading three, Extra Bold 800

Label and button text, Bold 700. Body text in Regular 400 reads well at 16px on the lilac page and on white cards.
